title: The `e2e` block of the fleet heartbeat (POST /v1/devices/heartbeat). The five base keys and the optional counters stay as they are (a control plane older than 2.0 refuses any other key with invalid_fleet_health_shape and the device falls back to the base shape); this object is one more optional key. Closed shape: no label, host, device id, address or free text. The Worker keeps only the latest block of each computer (overwritten) and counts over a 24-hour window from list metadata, with no identifier in any count (the contract, WP35 notes). bytes are the device's own totals for period_s. window is the device's random id for that byte window: a resend of an unaccepted window carries the same id and the same bytes, and the Worker adds a window's bytes to the day once (a 48 h marker per computer; a resend read before the first write has spread can still count twice, the contract, WP35 notes).
